decisions.instruction: Keep dependency lock update only when Aurion package graph requires it.
Aurion already carries React type packages; record as source delta, no duplicate dependency drift.
Rebuild guild, bank and kingdom routes behind Aurion session, capabilities and normalized transactions.
Reject JSON-blob and in-memory-success authority; normalize in Aurion MariaDB.
Do not replace Aurion App host; mount approved projections through AurionOpenWorldRuntime.
Map legendary drop cue to aurion:audio-cue; no second AudioContext authority.
Use as read/intent UI; all resource, yield, XP and item mutations come from Aurion receipts.
Synthetic server mirror is not production evidence; adapt only to real server hashes/receipts.
Replace simulated party, teleport and rewards with server queue, tickets and completion receipts.
Adopt with production stack/detail disclosure guard.
Expose new actions from server-approved readmodels; no local outcome state.
Use as intent/read projection; remove local mutation success and client ownership claims.
Fix hook order and bind blueprints to Aurion housing placement receipts.
Paperdoll/filter/pity projection only; inventory and gear score remain server-owned.
Sell/buyback require atomic item custody and treasury transactions.
Adopt content/read projection; unlock and completion require quest/lore receipts.
Boss and territory live state come from Aurion epoch/tick readmodels.
Adopt with reference counting and deterministic disposal lifecycle.
Use articulated fallback behind Aurion GLB catalog and ops upload authority.
Selectively port orchestration; do not reintroduce standalone authority paths.
Adopt render-only VFX; exclude visual RNG from authoritative hashes.
Replace simulated/local party state with Aurion membership, role and reward receipts.
Adopt geometry changes behind server-approved equipment readmodels.
Definitions only; spawn, defeat, slayer and respawn state are server-owned.
Seed/catalog only; never represent persisted live guild state.
Normalize homestead blueprints and content IDs.
Normalize professions/recipes/dungeons/lore; remove caps and local Number XP authority.
Compatibility getters may be ported without changing memory authority.
tickCount getter may be ported as read-only instrumentation.
Remove local hero fallback as authority; use confirmed Aurion player/target state.
Port header guard and add full bounds/fuzz checks.
Rewrite pity and auto-loot through deterministic server loot and collect receipts.
Port meshes/animation; spawns, levels and drops derive from Aurion encounter plan.
Port refined geometry only; progression and equipment remain server projections.
Keep explicit dev/test only; never display as live online players.
Split content DTOs, readmodels, intents and server receipts; avoid monolithic authority type.
Map to normalized Aurion guild/kingdom domain and capability contract.
Render confirmed homestead deltas only; server owns placement, collision and IDs.
